lines.text: mov.l   #pPackedTargetCurrentGearRange, r2; Live-verified packed 5EAT gear/range byte. Upper nibble = target/requested gear/range; lower nibble = current gear/range. Observed stable encoding: 8=Park, 7=Reverse, 0=Neutral/no forward gear, 1..5=forward gears 1..5. Examples: 0x21=target 2/current 1, 0x45=target 4/current 5.
mov.l   #pTargetGearRangeCode, r3; Decoded target/requested gear/range from upper nibble of FFFF4C8D. Decoder maps encoded 8 to 0.
mov.l   #pTargetGearRangeCode, r1; Decoded target/requested gear/range from upper nibble of FFFF4C8D. Decoder maps encoded 8 to 0.
mov.l   #pCurrentGearRangeCode, r6; Decoded current 5EAT gear/range from lower nibble of FFFF4C8D. Live observed 0=N/no forward gear, 1..5=forward gears, 7=Reverse. Decoder maps Park code 8 to 0.
mov.l   #pTcuStatusFlags_candidate, r0; Returns 1 when bit 0x02 of FFFF4C50 is set; returns 0 when it is clear. This condition is also required inside sUpdateTcuDerivedSnapshot.

mov.l   #pTcuDerivedDataValid, r8; TCU-derived-data validity latch. Set to 1 on successful update path at 0x15B66; later required to equal 1 at 0x15C14; cleared on update failure/abort paths at 0x15C5A and 0x15D26. Dedicated snapshot reset function 0x15D46 does not itself clear this byte.
mov.l   #pPackedTargetCurrentGearRangeSource, r0; Source byte copied directly to FFFF4C8D at 0x15AF2. FFFF4C8D is live-verified packed target/current 5EAT gear/range.

mov.l   #pPackedTargetCurrentGearRange, r2; Live-verified packed 5EAT gear/range byte. Upper nibble = target/requested gear/range; lower nibble = current gear/range. Observed stable encoding: 8=Park, 7=Reverse, 0=Neutral/no forward gear, 1..5=forward gears 1..5. Examples: 0x21=target 2/current 1, 0x45=target 4/current 5.

mov.l   #pTcuStatusFlags_candidate, r0; Transmission-related status flags. Bit 0x02 is tested by sTestTcuStatusMask02 and is required by the TCU-derived snapshot/update path. If absent, the update routine clears pTcuDerivedDataValid. Whole-byte semantics not yet proven.

mov.l   #pPackedTargetCurrentGearRange, r2; Live-verified packed 5EAT gear/range byte. Upper nibble = target/requested gear/range; lower nibble = current gear/range. Observed stable encoding: 8=Park, 7=Reverse, 0=Neutral/no forward gear, 1..5=forward gears 1..5. Examples: 0x21=target 2/current 1, 0x45=target 4/current 5.
mov.l   #pCurrentGearRangeCode, r3; Decoded current 5EAT gear/range from lower nibble of FFFF4C8D. Live observed 0=N/no forward gear, 1..5=forward gears, 7=Reverse. Decoder maps Park code 8 to 0.
mov.l   #pNormalizedCurrentGearIndex, r13; Live A2WC511R 5EAT observation: P/N=0, R=1, forward gears 1..5=1..5. OEM code can also assign 6.
mov.l   #pNormalizedCurrentGearState, r14; Live A2WC511R 5EAT observation: P/N=6, R=1, forward gears 1..5=1..5. Reverse is normalized to 1.
mov.l   #pNormalizedCurrentGearState, r2; Live A2WC511R 5EAT observation: P/N=6, R=1, forward gears 1..5=1..5. Reverse is normalized to 1.
